annotations.title: Study pack for any topic: flashcards, quiz, review plan

description: A topic in, a ready-to-teach pack out: summary, key points, 4-20 flashcards, a 3-12 question multiple-choice quiz with explanations and a balanced answer key, common misconceptions, a 30-day spaced review plan, an Anki import file and a printable worksheet, in 14 languages. PAID: 8 Iris Credits with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer iris_... header or the key argument; packs from $0.25, buyable with a plain USDC transfer, see payment_options), or $0.040 per call with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base) or MPP over MCP (USDC.e on Tempo). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected first; failed work is never charged (credits are refunded). Same result as GET /v1/study/pack.

key.description: Optional Iris Credits key (iris_ + 48 hex). Better: set it once as the MCP header Authorization: Bearer <key>. Without a key the call is paid with x402 / MPP over MCP.

lang.description: Language of the whole pack. Default en.

topic.description: What to study, 2-120 characters (e.g. "the French Revolution", "Python list comprehensions", "IELTS cohesive devices"). Default: photosynthesis (demo).
